name: Haydée Pérez Garrido

name: Héctor Villarreal Páez
detail: Conditional openness ('if we are going to discuss a wealth tax, it is fine if it is reasonable'), not support.

name: Raúl Carbajal

name: Raymundo Campos Vázquez
detail: Quote is about measuring wealth for such a tax, not support for it.

name: Gustavo del Ángel Mobarak
detail: Quote ('for the government it would be an alternative') is too vague to count.

name: Diego de la Mora
detail: Quote asks to raise the taxes of the very rich in general, not a wealth tax.

detail: Author credit on a 2022 Oxfam fiscal-reform report that mentions a wealth tax once, as a future step.

detail: Credit on a 2022 Oxfam fiscal-reform report that mentions a wealth tax once, as a future step.

name: Mónica Unda Gutiérrez

name: Ifigenia Martínez Hernández
detail: Died on 5 October 2024 (Ifigenia Martínez Hernández, economist and President of the Chamber of Deputies).

name: Ervin Félix López
detail: Author credit on an Oxfam report whose only mention of taxing large fortunes is in a list of goals.

name: Gustavo Esteva
detail: Mexican ecosocial pact signatory and founder of Universidad de la Tierra; died 17 March 2022.

name: Horacio Sosa Villavicencio
detail: Oaxaca deputy proposed a federal tax on large fortunes for taxpayers with annual incomes over MXN 500 million; available record does not clearly specify a wealth-stock tax rather than an income tax. Motion was referred to committee, not adopted in the recorded session.

name: Noelia Méndez Santolaria
detail: Argentina-based economist who coauthored a Mexico–Argentina report. The register prioritises people in their home area.

name: Luis Monroy-Gómez-Franco
detail: OECD chapter cites his background study and models a wealth tax, but the quoted passage does not establish his own endorsement.

name: Alberto González Pandiella
detail: OECD editor revised a chapter modelling a wealth tax; this is insufficient to establish his personal endorsement.
